start_from: the project root, so that the package 'src' can be imported

label.decision_rule: predicted class is 1 when the probability of class 1 is above decision_threshold; model.predict() already applies it

input_fields.name: complaint_type
input_fields.description: Kind of request, as in the NYC 311 data. Any case or spacing is accepted. A type the model has never seen is treated as 'Other'.

input_fields.name: borough
input_fields.description: One of the five boroughs. Any case is accepted; anything else is treated as 'Unknown'.

input_fields.name: created_at
input_fields.type: string (ISO 8601 date and time, no time zone needed)
input_fields.description: When the request was filed. The server derives hour, weekday, month and the weekend flag from it.

input_fields.name: descriptor
input_fields.description: More detail about the complaint. Missing becomes 'Unknown'; unseen text becomes 'Other'.

input_fields.name: location_type
input_fields.description: Kind of place. Missing becomes 'Unknown'; unseen text becomes 'Other'.

input_fields.name: incident_zip
input_fields.description: 5-digit New York ZIP code, as text. An invalid ZIP becomes 'Unknown'; a ZIP not among the common ones becomes 'Other'.

input_fields.name: latitude
input_fields.description: Missing is allowed. Phase 7 should reject values that are impossible (outside -90..90) with HTTP 422; values inside that range but outside the New York box below are treated as missing by the cleaning step.

input_fields.name: longitude
input_fields.description: Missing is allowed; same rules as latitude (impossible means outside -180..180). If only one of latitude and longitude is given, both are treated as missing.

input_fields_note: The API receives 9 raw fields. The model uses 12 features: 8 of these fields plus hour, weekday, month and is_weekend, which are derived from created_at.

pipeline.step 1 clean: RequestCleaner (src/features.py): the Phase 3 cleaning, rare categories to 'Other', time features
pipeline.step 2 encode: ColumnTransformer: one-hot for the text columns, scaled coordinates with a 'missing' flag, scaled time features

fitted_on: the training split only (not refitted on train + validation)

model.class_weighting: scale_pos_weight below 1: the common class (resolved within 7 days) counts less
model.chosen_by: Phase 5: cross-validation on the training split (reports/tuning_results.csv)

previous_versions.description: stacking classifier (XGBoost + Logistic Regression + Naive Bayes + Random Forest, cut-off 0.61); file models/model_stack_v2.joblib (not in Git); git tag phase7-stack-v2
previous_versions.why_not_deployed: did not reach XGBoost alone on validation macro F1 (-0.12 points); about 11 times larger and several times slower

previous_versions.description: first stacking classifier (XGBoost + Naive Bayes + Random Forest); git tag phase6-v1

decision_note: Deployed model chosen by the course instructor's rule: if the stacking model is not as good as XGBoost alone, use XGBoost alone. See notebooks/06_final_model_xgboost.ipynb.
